\chapter{Learning Theory — Hoeffding}
%%% generated by the blueprint pipeline from TCSlib.LearningTheory.Hedge.Hoeffding
\section{Overview}

This module develops the analytic lemmas underlying Hoeffding's lemma for the Hedge
(multiplicative-weights) algorithm.  Starting from the convexity of the exponential
function, it derives a chain of bounds culminating in two log-MGF inequalities:
a weak bound with constant $\eta^2/2$ and a tight bound with constant $\eta^2/8$.

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
\section{Declarations}

\begin{lemma}[$x(1-x) \le 1/4$]
\lean{mul_one_sub_le_quarter}
\label{mul_one_sub_le_quarter}
\leanok
\difficulty{2}
For any $x \in [0,1]$, the product $x(1-x) \le \tfrac{1}{4}$.
\end{lemma}

\begin{theorem}[Convexity bound for the exponential]
\lean{exp_convexity_bound'}
\label{exp_convexity_bound'}
\leanok
\difficulty{4}
For any $\eta, x \in \bbr$ with $x \in [0,1]$, convexity of $\exp$ gives
\[
  e^{-\eta x} \;\le\; 1 - x + x\,e^{-\eta}.
\]
\end{theorem}

\begin{theorem}[Weighted exponential sum vs.\ affine upper bound]
\lean{weighted_exp_le_affine}
\label{weighted_exp_le_affine}
\leanok
\uses{exp_convexity_bound'}
\difficulty{3}
Let $p : \mathrm{Fin}\,n \to \bbr$ be a probability vector ($p_i \ge 0$,
$\sum_i p_i = 1$) and let $\ell : \mathrm{Fin}\,n \to \bbr$ satisfy $0 \le \ell_i \le 1$
for all $i$.  For any $\eta \in \bbr$,
\[
  \sum_{i} p_i \,e^{-\eta\,\ell_i}
  \;\le\;
  1 - \bigl(1 - e^{-\eta}\bigr)\!\sum_{i} p_i\,\ell_i.
\]
\end{theorem}

\begin{theorem}[$\ln(1+u) \le u$]
\lean{log_one_add_le}
\label{log_one_add_le}
\leanok
\difficulty{2}
For any $u > -1$, $\ln(1+u) \le u$.
\end{theorem}

\begin{theorem}[$\eta - 1 + e^{-\eta} \le \eta^2/2$]
\lean{eta_exp_bound}
\label{eta_exp_bound}
\leanok
\difficulty{5}
For any $\eta \ge 0$,
\[
  \eta - 1 + e^{-\eta} \;\le\; \frac{\eta^2}{2}.
\]
\end{theorem}

\begin{theorem}[Weak Hoeffding log-MGF bound]
\lean{hoeffding_log_mgf_weak}
\label{hoeffding_log_mgf_weak}
\leanok
\uses{eta_exp_bound}
\difficulty{5}
Let $p$ be a probability vector on $\mathrm{Fin}\,n$ and let $\ell_i \in [0,1]$ for all
$i$.  For $\eta > 0$, setting $L = \sum_i p_i \ell_i$,
\[
  \ln\!\Bigl(\sum_{i} p_i\,e^{-\eta\,\ell_i}\Bigr)
  \;\le\;
  -\eta L + \frac{\eta^2}{2}.
\]
\end{theorem}

\begin{theorem}[Bernoulli MGF bound (Hoeffding's lemma)]
\lean{bernoulli_mgf_bound}
\label{bernoulli_mgf_bound}
\leanok
\difficulty{7}
For $L \in [0,1]$ and any $\eta \in \bbr$,
\[
  \ln\!\bigl(1 - L + L\,e^{-\eta}\bigr)
  \;\le\;
  -L\eta + \frac{\eta^2}{8}.
\]
The bound is established by showing that the function
$\varphi(\eta) = -L\eta + \eta^2/8 - \ln(1-L+Le^{-\eta})$ is convex with
$\varphi(0) = 0$ and $\varphi'(0) = 0$.
\end{theorem}

\begin{theorem}[Tight Hoeffding log-MGF bound]
\lean{hoeffding_log_mgf_tight}
\label{hoeffding_log_mgf_tight}
\leanok
\uses{bernoulli_mgf_bound, weighted_exp_le_affine}
\difficulty{4}
Under the same hypotheses as \texttt{hoeffding\_log\_mgf\_weak}, the tighter bound holds:
\[
  \ln\!\Bigl(\sum_{i} p_i\,e^{-\eta\,\ell_i}\Bigr)
  \;\le\;
  -\eta L + \frac{\eta^2}{8}.
\]
This follows by first applying \texttt{weighted\_exp\_le\_affine} and then
\texttt{bernoulli\_mgf\_bound}.
\end{theorem}
